lastCompletedStory.title: Wire notifyOrchestrator in host.ts/buildSupervisorOptions via getOrchPaneId + buildWorkerReportSendKeysArgv

nextStoryContext: US-002 wired notifyOrchestrator into buildSupervisorOptions via makeNotifyOrchestrator (exported from host.ts). The closure uses a TmuxSpawnFn adapter over spawnSync, calls getOrchPaneId to find the orch pane, and sends the verdict line via buildWorkerReportSendKeysArgv (no -l, Enter as separate key, one call). The loop already calls notifyOrchestrator after review dispatch (US-001). US-003 and beyond can rely on the full pipeline being wired.
